prompt:
CONCEPT: a female personification of Zhou Tai (주태), a general of Eastern Wu in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms — the guardian whose body became covered with scars saving Sun Quan. Reimagined as a woman; her costume, ornaments, colours and bearing carry her famous deeds and temperament. This is a character design, not a historical portrait.
STYLE: Premium Korean MMORPG promotional character render — an in-engine 3D character model with hand-painted textures, not flat cel shading and not a 2D anime illustration: semi-realistic volumetric forms, porcelain skin with a soft subsurface glow and glossy specular highlights, a small refined face with delicate realistic-anime features, long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure — soft, rounded volume at bust, hips and thighs in the body type SILHOUETTE names; never thin, flat or boyishly straight. Polished metal, silk and gems catch sharp highlights. Extremely intricate ornamented costume — filigree metalwork, jewel inlays, layered translucent fabrics and fine embroidery. Character-select-screen lighting: strong rim light, soft key light on the face, drifting light particles, atmospheric depth with a softly blurred background. Luxurious, high-detail finish.
TRAITS of Zhou Tai to carry in her design and the scene: countless scars each with a story, unwavering loyalty, heavy armor.
FACTION — Eastern Wu. Palette: crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer.
AGE: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
SILHOUETTE: strong and broad-shouldered with firm muscle, yet full-busted with wide rounded hips and a defined waist build; an elegant low chignon with short baby bangs; blue-black hair with a cold indigo sheen.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a rugged, tough, outdoorsy look; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; round face; smaller, narrower eyes than usual anime proportion — peach-blossom eyes with a soft, curved lower lid, outer eye corners drooping downward; soft rounded brows; straight narrow nose; full wide lips; ember-orange eyes; a thin faint scar through one eyebrow.
WORLD — MECHA: year 2190, the Wu carrier fleet in orbit above an ocean world: crimson starships and carriers, a glowing nebula, the planet's blue oceans and storm clouds below, neon running lights on the hulls. MECHA DESIGN: she is a female mecha personification, built as an assault-type mecha frame — heavy armor plates, thruster packs, reinforced limbs, her weapon rebuilt as a large mecha armament; plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry her faction palette and the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; her signature item is rebuilt as part of the frame or as a mecha armament. Mecha plating covers her frame except where EXPOSURE opens it — no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates; any cape is rigid armored binder plates. Her face and hair stay human. The setting is far-future science fiction — space stations, starships, planets, nebulae and high-tech structures; no traditional East-Asian architecture, no pagodas, tiled roofs or stone lanterns. FACTION FRAME: crimson and black lacquer plating with gold edges, streamlined naval hull shapes and fin binders, hydrojet thrusters, flame-orange glow lines.
MECHA SILHOUETTE: several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely.
MOOD: sleek sci-fi key art — clean reflective plates, glowing light lines, hovering light particles and a soft bloom.
EXPOSURE (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates, and a bare waist and midriff between the bust plate and the hip armor; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
SIGNATURE ITEM: a broad saber — rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour and no wood, silk tassels or forged-bronze fittings. She holds or carries it, drawn at full scale. It is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
EXPRESSION: a level, steady look, mouth closed. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no horse or other creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.

observations: 남빛 검정 머리·따뜻한 금빛 피부·붉은색/금색/리버틸/검정 팔레트 유지. 여성 전신과 양발·손, 자연스러운 얼굴·굴곡 체형 및 팔다리 수 확인.
지정 bold 노출과 일치하며 은밀 부위는 가려짐. 실제 동물과 다른 주인물 없음. 상처는 아문 흉터 또는 수선된 장갑으로 표현.
대도 아래 칼끝이 프레임 경계에 닿아 일부 잘림.
세계별 룬과 마법 빛 또는 메카 장갑판과 발광 에너지 날 확인. 읽히는 문구 없음.
